topic: Three numbers to check before any mining decision
hook: Before you look at any mining offer, check these three numbers.

scenes.narration: How much hashing power are you actually getting, measured in terahashes per second?
How many watts per terahash? Lower means lower electricity costs.
What maintenance or hosting charges come out of the rewards? Costs decide your net result.

cta: Want to explore how digital Bitcoin mining works? Check the link on my channel page.
title: 3 Numbers to Check Before Any Bitcoin Mining Decision
description_body: A beginner's checklist: hashrate, efficiency and ongoing fees. Mining involves costs and risk.
